programme.title: Asterix and Obelix in the Middle Kingdom / Asterix and Obelix im Reich der Mitte
programme.desc: In the year 50 BC there was a coup d'état in China. Prince Deng Tsin Qin takes the Chinese empress. The Princess Wun Da can escape to Europe with the help of her bodyguard and is looking for support from the Gauls. Asterix and Obelix are ready to travel to China to free the Empress and end the overthrow. And Casar also hopes to achieve fame and honor in the Middle Kingdom. / Im Jahr 50 vor Christus ist es in China zu einem Staatsstreich gekommen. Asterix und Obelix sind bereit, nach China zu reisen, um die Kaiserin zu befreien und den Umsturz zu beenden. Und auch Casar hofft, Ruhm und Ehre im Reich der Mitte zu erlangen.

programme.title: Jurassic World
programme.desc: It was 22 years ago that the billionard John Hammond cloned the first dinosaurs. With improved technologies and security measures, the new Park Jurassic World is now being opened on the same island on which its amusement park was once created. In order to offer the spectators a special highlight, a predator was specially breeded that never existed in nature: the Indominus Rex. However, this will soon escape and the leisure pass will become a struggle for survival. / Es ist mittlerweile 22 Jahre her, dass der Milliardar John Hammond den ersten Dinosaurier geklont hat. Mit verbesserten Technologien und SicherheitsmaSSnahmen wird nun auf derselben Insel, auf der einst sein Vergnugungspark entstand, der neue Park Jurassic World eroffnet. Um den Zuschauern ein besonderes Highlight zu bieten, wurde eigens ein Raubtier gezuchtet, das es in der Natur nie gab: der Indominus Rex. Dem gelingt aber bald die Flucht und aus dem FreizeitspaSS wird ein Kampf ums Überleben.

programme.title: Jenseits von Afrika
programme.desc: Karen marries her cousin Bror and builds a coffee plantation in Kenya with him, but her marriage is not a happiness. Karen's life suddenly different when she gets to know the attractive Safari hunter Denys and falls in love with him. When the war breaks out, Tania proves her enormous energy: in a week -long trek across Kenya, she succeeds in supplying the troops with vital supplies. From now on she is considered the most extraordinary woman in the colony. / Karen heiratet ihren Cousin Bror und baut mit ihm zusammen eine Kaffeeplantage in Kenia auf, doch ihre Ehe ist keine gluckliche. Karens Leben andert sich schlagartig, als sie den attraktiven Safari-Jager Denys kennenlernt und sich in ihn verliebt. Als der Krieg ausbricht, beweist Tania ihre enorme Tatkraft: In einem wochenlangen Treck quer durch Kenia gelingt es ihr, die Truppen mit lebensnotwendigen Nachschub zu versorgen. Von nun an gilt sie als die auSSergewohnlichste Frau in der Kolonie.

programme.title: Football - Wwin Liga BiH / Fudbal - WWin Liga BiH
programme.desc: Founded in 2000, the Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina is the highest rank of football competitions in BiH. With the entry of cubes from Republika Srpska, two years later, the league receives a format with 16 clubs in the two -round competition system. Today, 12 clubs compete in the league, which after 22 rounds are divided into the Champions League and League to stay. The first historic champion of BiH was Leotar from Trebinje. The club with the highest championship titles Zrinjski is from Mostar. The greatest European success is the placement of Željezničar in the UEFA semi -finals in 1984. / Osnovana 2000. godine Premijer liga Bosne i Hercegovine najviši je rang nogometnih natjecanja u BiH. Ulaskom kubova iz Republike Srpske dvije godine kasnije liga dobiva format sa 16 klubova u dvokružnom sistemu natjecanja. Danas se u ligi natječe 12 klubova koje se nakon 22 odigrana kola dijele na Ligu za prvaka i Ligu za ostanak. Prvi povijesni prvak BiH bio je Leotar iz Trebinja. Klub s najviše osvojenih naslova prvaka Zrinjski je iz Mostara. Najveći europski uspjeh plasman je Željezničara u polufinale kupa UEFA 1984. godine.

programme.title: Football - English League / Fudbal - Engleska liga
programme.desc: Every August 20 team begins hunting at the most respected trophy of English football. The English Premier in the format in which the game was founded in 1992. The first winter of the championship is the most trophy English football club, Manchester United. Sezona traje do maja u dvokružnom sistemu gde svaka ekipa kroz sezonu odigra 38 utakmica. Prvi osvajač prvenstva je najtrofejniji engleski fudbalski klub, Mančester Junajted. programme.title: FBBAL - Italian League / Fudbal - Italijanska liga
programme.desc: Italian series and is a professional football competition that counts 20 teams in the two-circular league championship. Since 1929, when she was founded, a series A became synonymous with tactical football. For many years, Italian football has considered the best in Europe with its quality and a series of great players and trainers. With the fall of the financial power of Italian first league and a series of corruption scandals, the league briefly fell in quality but is returned to the place where it belongs. / Italijanska Serija A profesionalno je fudbalsko takmičenje koje broji 20 momčadi u dvokružnom ligaškom prvenstvu. Još od 1929. godine kada je osnovana, Serija A je postala sinonim za taktički fudbal. Dugi niz godina italijanski se fudbal svojom kvalitetom te nizom sjajnih igrača i trenera smatrao najboljim u Evropi. Padom finansijske moći italijanskih prvoligaša te nizom korupcijskih skandala liga je nakratko pala u kvaliteti ali se sigurnim koracima vraća na mjesto gdje i pripada.

programme.title: FBBAL - Italian League / Fudbal - Italijanska liga
programme.desc: Italian series and is a professional football competition that counts 20 teams in the two-circular league championship. Since 1929, when she was founded, a series A became synonymous with tactical football. For many years, Italian football has considered the best in Europe with its quality and a series of great players and trainers. With the fall of the financial power of Italian first league and a series of corruption scandals, the league briefly fell in quality but is returned to the place where it belongs. / Italijanska Serija A profesionalno je fudbalsko takmičenje koje broji 20 momčadi u dvokružnom ligaškom prvenstvu. Još od 1929. godine kada je osnovana, Serija A je postala sinonim za taktički fudbal. Dugi niz godina italijanski se fudbal svojom kvalitetom te nizom sjajnih igrača i trenera smatrao najboljim u Evropi. Padom finansijske moći italijanskih prvoligaša te nizom korupcijskih skandala liga je nakratko pala u kvaliteti ali se sigurnim koracima vraća na mjesto gdje i pripada.

programme.title: Football - Spanish League / Fudbal - Španska liga
programme.desc: Primera or popular La Liga is the first Spanish football league. With as many as 22 conquered titles of the European Primary Champion, the Spanish Primera for years are considered the best European football league. Founded in 1929. year, the example counts 20 teams that in 38 cars are trying to collect the largest number of points. This is the most path to go to Madrid Real, while the other is the most successful Team Barcelona. With top teams of Spanish league, it adorns and extremely technical mentality of the game mostly clubs with the aim of overcoming opponents. / Primera ili popularno La Liga prva je španska fudbalska liga. Sa čak 22 osvojene titule prvaka Evrope španska Primera godinama se smatra najboljom evropskom fudbalskom ligom. Osnovana 1929. godine, Primera broji 20 ekipa koje u 38 kola sezone pokušavaju skupiti najveći broj bodova. To je najviše puta pošlo za rukom madridskom Realu dok je druga najuspješnija ekipa Barselona. Uz vrhunske ekipe špansku ligu krasi i izrazito tehnički mentalitet igre većine klubova sa ciljem za nadigravanjem protivnika.

programme.title: Football - Superliga Serbia / Fudbal - Superliga Srbije
programme.desc: The Serbian Super League has had its premiere in the 2006/2007 season. In today's league system, there are 20 teams and functions on the two-circular principle of competition. The history of the Super League was largely marked by two large Belgrade Rivals, Partizan and Red Star. Historically, according to the number of titles, the red-white part of the city is more successful. / Srpska Superliga svoju premijeru imala je u sezoni 2006./2007. U današnjem sistemu liga broji 20 ekipa i funkcionira po dvokružnom principu takmičenja. Historiju Superlige u najvećoj su mjeri obilježila dva velika beogradska rivala, Partizan i Crvena zvezda. Historijski gledano, po broju osvojenih naslova crveno-bijeli dio grada je uspješniji.

programme.title: Boks
programme.desc: Rocky Marciano, Mike Tyson, Sugar Ray Robinson, Muhammad Ali, Joe Louis. Do you need another reason to follow this noble martial skill? We find the first boxes of boxes already in the third stand before Christ on Sumerian drawings. In the modern age, the first rules of boxes were established 18. century in London and define the space of the fight, equipment and illicit and permitted types of blows. Don't miss every opportunity to enjoy this exciting sport. / Rocky Marciano, Mike Tyson, Sugar Ray Robinson, Muhammad Ali, Joe Louis. Treba li još koji razlog više za pratiti ovu plemenitu borilačku vještinu? Prve prikaze boksa nalazimo već u trećem stojeću prije Krista na sumeranskim crtežima. U modernom dobu prva pravila boksa ustanovljena su 18. stoljeću u Londonu te definiraju prostor borbe, opremu te nedozvoljene i dozvoljene vrste udaraca. Ne propustite svaku priliku za uživati u ovom uzbudljivom sportu.

programme.title: Football: HNL / Fudbal: HNL

Prijelazni kup namjenjen prvaku djelo je akademskog kipara Marijana Zaradića. Najviše puta osvajao ga je zagrebački Dinamo.

programme.desc: Every August 20 team begins hunting at the most respected trophy of English football. The English Premier in the format in which the game was founded in 1992. programme.title: Brasil x China
programme.desc: For the opening round of Group H, Brazil and China play at SM Mall of Asia Arena in Pasay, Philippines. programme.title: Brasil x Tchequia

programme.title: Sem Bloqueio

programme.title: Athletics: World Cup in Tokyo / Лека атлетика: Световно първенство в Токио
programme.desc: The best competitors in the Queen of Sports gather in Tokyo. 2200 athletes, representatives of 198 countries, will start in the Japanese capital in the first major outdoor championship from the new Olympic cycle. Rising stars and well-established characters will fight for the 49 sets of medals that will be distributed in Tokyo. The hosts of the championship and world athletics have taken into account the program so that all the most interesting disciplines are at a convenient time to watch in Europe. Bulgaria will be represented by its four best competitors. The European champion in a hall in the length of Bozhidar Saraboyukov will fight for a place among the best in the discipline. 10 years after her fourth place in Beijing, Gabriela Petrova will try to rank among the finalists on a triple jump. Plamen Mitkova in the length of length will again look for her place among the world elite after the fourth position of the World Championship in the hall in March. Tihomir Ivanov strives for the second consecutive planetary level after the eighth place last year at the Olympic Games in Paris. / Най-добрите състезатели в Царицата на спортовете се събират в Токио. 2200 лекоатлети, представители на 198 страни, ще стартират в японската столица в първия голям шампионат на открито от новия олимпийски цикъл. Изгряващи звезди и утвърдени герои ще влязат в борба за 49-те комплекта медали, които ще се разпределят в Токио. Домакините на шампионата и Световната атлетика са съобразили програмата така, че всички най-интересни дисциплини да бъдат в удобно за гледане в Европа време. България ще бъде представена от четиримата си най-добри състезатели. Европейският шампион в зала в скока на дължина Божидар Саръбоюков ще се бори за място сред най-добрите в дисциплината. 10 години след четвъртото си място в Пекин, Габриела Петрова ще се опита да се нареди сред финалистките на троен скок. Пламена Миткова в скока на дължина отново ще търси своето място сред световния елит след четвъртата позиция на световния шампионат в зала през март. Тихомир Иванов се стреми към втори пореден финал на планетарно ниво след осмото място през миналата година на Олимпийските игри в Париж.

programme.title: Cycling: Tour of Germany / Колоездене: Обиколка на Германия
programme.desc: The tour of Germany is one of the largest and most prestigious cycling competitions in Germany. This is a multi -day race, which is usually held in late summer and attracts top cyclists from around the world. Germany is known for its beautiful and diverse routes that offer both flat stages and serious mountain climbs, which makes the competition extremely exciting and contested. / Обиколката на Германия е едно от най-големите и престижни състезания по колоездене в Германия. Това е многодневно състезание, което обикновено се провежда в края на лятото и привлича топ колоездачи от целия свят. Германия е известна със своите красиви и разнообразни маршрути, които предлагат както равнинни етапи, така и сериозни планински изкачвания, което прави състезанието изключително вълнуващо и оспорвано.

programme.title: LEtape Bulgaria by Tour de France
programme.desc: Declaced documentary. / Обзорен документален филм.

programme.title: Tourism.bg / Туризъм.бг
programme.desc: Weekly television broadcast dedicated to Bulgarian tourism. The team travels all over Bulgaria and promotes Bulgarian cities as attractive tourist destinations. Only in our show time stops and you can walk through the captivating and beautiful Bulgarian mountains, to conquer the highest native peaks, to take the steepest forest paths. Get to know us the most challenging tourist routes and immerse yourself in the past with the most exciting historical collections of Bulgaria. / Седмично телевизионно предаване, посветено на българския туризъм. Екипът пътува в цяла България и популяризира български градове като атрактивни туристически дестинации. Само в нашето предаване времето спира и можете да се разхождате из пленителните и красиви български планини, да покорите най-високите родни върхове, да превземете най-стръмните горски пътеки. Опознайте с нас най- предизвикателните туристически маршрути и се потопете в миналото с най-вълнуващите исторически сбирки на България.

programme.title: In the rhythm of the city / В ритъма на града
programme.desc: The show brings together the most interesting of worldly life. Topical topics from the world of show business, meetings with interesting young people, with followers on the nets will be awaited. We will hear the rhythm on the street, and Ai Jen Za will help the leader with Wirel news. / Предаването събира най-интересното от светския живот. Ще ви очакват актуални теми от света на шоубизнеса, срещи с интересни млади хора, с последователи в мрежите. Ще чуем ритъма на улицата, а AI Джен Зи ще помага на водещата с вайръл новините.

programme.title: Hall of Fame: Zhivko Vangelov / Зала на славата: Живко Вангелов
programme.desc: "Hall of Fame" is a section in which we present the most famous faces of the great golden galaxy of Bulgarian athletes. These significant names, which, with their success over the years, have enjoyed sports lovers in our country. In the Hall of Glory, they tell about themselves - about successes, disappointments, difficulties, peaks, about the past and the present, about sports, which plays a huge role in life and for life after sports. Thanks to the rich archive of Bulgarian National Television, you will have the opportunity to see the biggest successes of the stars of Bulgarian sport. / "Зала на славата" е рубрика, в която представяме най-известните лица от голямата златна плеяда български спортисти. Тези значими имена, които със своите успехи през годините са радвали любителите на спорта в нашата страна. В "Зала на славата" те разказват за себе си - за успехите, разочарованията, трудностите, върховете, за миналото и настоящето, за спорта, който играе огромна роля в живота и за живота след спорта. Благодарение на богатия архив на Българската национална телевизия ще имате възможност да видите и най-големите успехи на звездите на българския спорт.

programme.title: Fight: World Cup: Classic Style, Finals / Борба: Световно първенство: Класически стил, финали
programme.desc: Bulgaria will be represented by 14 competitors. The first free -style participants will be released on the Tepeha, who will distribute medals in the days from September 14 to 16. Seven will be the Bulgarian fighters - Ivaylo Tisov /57 kg /, Mikya Naim /65 kg /, Mihail Georgiev /70 kg /, Ramadan Ramazanov /74 kg /, Ahmed Bataev /92 kg /, Ahmed Magamaev /97 kg /and Alen Hubulov /125 kg /. The women enter the battle for the honors from September 16 to September 18, with the Bulgarians will be 3 - Bilyana Dudova /62 kg /, Juliana Yaneva /68 kg /and Vanessa Georgieva /76 kg /. The last three days have been designated for the classical style categories, with four being there will be the Bulgarian representatives there - Nikolay Vichev /63 kg /, David Dimitrov /72 kg /, Stoyan Kubatov /77 kg /and Daniel Alexandrov /87 kg /. / България ще бъде представена от 14 състезатели. Първи на тепеха излизат участниците в свободния стил, които ще разпределят медалите в дните от 14 до 16 септември. Седем ще са българските борци – Ивайло Тисов /57 кг/, Микяй Наим /65 кг/, Михаил Георгиев /70 кг/, Рамазан Рамазанов /74 кг/, Ахмед Батаев /92 кг/, Ахмед Магамаев /97 кг/ и Ален Хубулов /125 кг/. Жените влизат в битка за отличията от 16 до 18 септември, като там българките ще бъдат 3 – Биляна Дудова /62 кг/, Юлияна Янева /68 кг/ и Ванеса Георгиева /76 кг/. Последните три дни са отредени за категориите в класическия стил, като четирима ще бъдат българските представители там – Николай Вичев /63 кг/, Дейвид Димитров /72 кг/, Стоян Кубатов /77 кг/ и Даниел Александров /87 кг/.

Домакините на шампионата и Световната атлетика са съобразили програмата така, че всички най-интересни дисциплини да бъдат в удобно за гледане в Европа време. България ще бъде представена от четиримата си най-добри състезатели. Европейският шампион в зала в скока на дължина Божидар Саръбоюков ще се бори за място сред най-добрите в дисциплината. 10 години след четвъртото си място в Пекин, Габриела Петрова ще се опита да се нареди сред финалистките на троен скок. Пламена Миткова в скока на дължина отново ще търси своето място сред световния елит след четвъртата позиция на световния шампионат в зала през март. Тихомир Иванов се стреми към втори пореден финал на планетарно ниво след осмото място през миналата година на Олимпийските игри в Париж.

programme.title: Fight: World Cup: Classic Style, Finals / Борба: Световно първенство: Класически стил, финали
programme.desc: Bulgaria will be represented by 14 competitors. The first free -style participants will be released on the Tepeha, who will distribute medals in the days from September 14 to 16. Seven will be the Bulgarian fighters - Ivaylo Tisov /57 kg /, Mikya Naim /65 kg /, Mihail Georgiev /70 kg /, Ramadan Ramazanov /74 kg /, Ahmed Bataev /92 kg /, Ahmed Magamaev /97 kg /and Alen Hubulov /125 kg /. The women enter the battle for the honors from September 16 to September 18, with the Bulgarians will be 3 - Bilyana Dudova /62 kg /, Juliana Yaneva /68 kg /and Vanessa Georgieva /76 kg /. The last three days have been designated for the classical style categories, with four being there will be the Bulgarian representatives there - Nikolay Vichev /63 kg /, David Dimitrov /72 kg /, Stoyan Kubatov /77 kg /and Daniel Alexandrov /87 kg /. / България ще бъде представена от 14 състезатели. Първи на тепеха излизат участниците в свободния стил, които ще разпределят медалите в дните от 14 до 16 септември. Седем ще са българските борци – Ивайло Тисов /57 кг/, Микяй Наим /65 кг/, Михаил Георгиев /70 кг/, Рамазан Рамазанов /74 кг/, Ахмед Батаев /92 кг/, Ахмед Магамаев /97 кг/ и Ален Хубулов /125 кг/. Жените влизат в битка за отличията от 16 до 18 септември, като там българките ще бъдат 3 – Биляна Дудова /62 кг/, Юлияна Янева /68 кг/ и Ванеса Георгиева /76 кг/. Последните три дни са отредени за категориите в класическия стил, като четирима ще бъдат българските представители там – Николай Вичев /63 кг/, Дейвид Димитров /72 кг/, Стоян Кубатов /77 кг/ и Даниел Александров /87 кг/.

programme.title: Wolf totem / Вълчи тотем
programme.desc: In 1967, the Cultural Revolution in China was in full swing. Student Chen Jun, along with his colleagues, arrives from Beijing to educate the Mongol nomads. The party orders the newborn wolves to be killed, but he attaches to them and secretly saves a little wolf and takes care of him. The boss Bao entrusted the army horses to the nomads, but the horses freeze in an ice lake, put there by the wolf pack left without food. The gazelles that the wolves keep are stolen by speculators. The nomads are slowly pushed and losing their land. The wolves were killed. Chen John's wolf is growing and released. Chen Jun wrote a book that became the most read after Mao Zedong's "Little Red Book". / През 1967 година културната революция в Китай е в разгара си. Студентът Чън Джън, заедно със свои колеги, пристига от Пекин, за да образова монголските номади. Партията издава заповед новородените вълчета да бъдат убивани, но той се привързва към тях и тайно спасява малко вълче и се грижи за него. Началникът Бао поверява армейските коне на номадите, но конете замръзват в ледено езеро, вкарани там от вълчата глутница, която е останала без храна. Газелите, които вълците пазят, са откраднати от спекуланти. Полека номадите са изтласкани и губят земите си. Вълците са избити. Вълчето на Чън Джън пораства и е пуснато на свобода. Чън Джън написва книга, която става най-четената след "Малката червена книга" на Мао Дзедун.

programme.title: Skandalozno ponašanje
programme.desc: The Miss World Choice in 1970 was held in London and the presenter was American comedian Bob Hope. At that time it was the most watched TV show in the world, with more than 100 million spectators. By claiming that beauty competitions portray women as sexual objects, a new movement for the liberation of women overnight gained fame with fall on stage and interfere with the transmission of the choice. / Izbor za Miss svijeta 1970. održao se u Londonu, a voditelj je bio američki komičar Bob Hope. U ono je vrijeme to bio najgledaniji TV show na svijetu, s više od 100 milijuna gledatelja. Tvrdeći da natjecanja u ljepoti prikazuju žene kao seksualne objekte, novi pokret za oslobođenje žena preko noći je stekao slavu upadom na pozornicu i ometanjem prijenosa izbora.

programme.title: Ask me anything / Pitaj me bilo što
programme.desc: Beautiful, wild and a little lost, Katie Kampenfelt pauses the year before college to find himself. Records his adventures in an anonymous blog in which he reveals his inner secrets, and over time the dark parts of her past are inflamed to the surface. / Lijepa, divlja i pomalo izgubljena, Katie Kampenfelt pauzira godinu prije fakulteta da bi pronašla sebe. Bilježi svoje avanture u anonimnom blogu u kojem otkriva svoje unutrašnje tajne, a s vremenom mračni dijelovi njezine prošlosti isplivavaju na površinu.

programme.title: Dijete Ozirisa
programme.desc: The film is located at the time of the interplanetary colonization, where we meet Sya Lombroka, a former paramedic of a dark past running out of prison. He will make an unusual alliance with Kane Sommerville, a sergeant who works for the exor military company. In the race over time, the two of them will try to save Kane's daughter of Indi, and prevent a global crisis that could cause exor. / Film je smješten u vrijeme međuplanetarne kolonizacije, gdje upoznajemo Sya Lombroka, bivšeg bolničara mračne prošlosti koji bježi iz zatvora. On će sklopiti neobično savezništvo s Kaneom Sommervilleom, narednikom koji radi za vojnu kompaniju Exor. U trci s vremenom, njih dvojica će pokušati spasiti Kaneovu kći Indi, i spriječiti globalnu krizu koju bi mogao izazvati Exor.

programme.title: Skandalozno ponašanje
programme.desc: The Miss World Choice in 1970 was held in London and the presenter was American comedian Bob Hope. At that time it was the most watched TV show in the world, with more than 100 million spectators. By claiming that beauty competitions portray women as sexual objects, a new movement for the liberation of women overnight gained fame with fall on stage and interfere with the transmission of the choice. / Izbor za Miss svijeta 1970. održao se u Londonu, a voditelj je bio američki komičar Bob Hope. U ono je vrijeme to bio najgledaniji TV show na svijetu, s više od 100 milijuna gledatelja. Tvrdeći da natjecanja u ljepoti prikazuju žene kao seksualne objekte, novi pokret za oslobođenje žena preko noći je stekao slavu upadom na pozornicu i ometanjem prijenosa izbora.

programme.title: Football - Europe League / Nogomet - Europa liga
programme.desc: UEFA Europa League Highlights - (Sport. Program) The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe has been officially under the auspices of UEFA since 1971. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Fair Cup, which was played from 1955 to 1971. Since that season, the competition has been officially called the UEFA Cup and is under this name until 2009 when it was renamed the UEFA League of Europe. During the years, the format has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. A group competition was introduced after which elimination followed. The trophy for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the UEFA Cup finals by Italian artist Bertoni and is awarded to the winner every year, which keeps him for a year ... / UEFA Europa League Highlights - (sport. program) Drugo najprestižnije klupsko nogometno natjecanje u Europi je službeno pod okriljem UEFA-e od 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog natjecanja bio je Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim je nazivom sve do 2009. godine kada je preimenovano u Uefa Ligu Europe. Tokom godina format se nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedeno je natjecanje po skupinama nakon kojeg slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake se godine dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana...

programme.title: WaPo Duisburg
programme.desc: A homeless person is found dead in the inner port. Carsten Heinrich von der Kripo quickly does the case as a suicide and the "Wapo" drives the identification of the victim. Marcel Bautz is already waiting impatiently on the guard: he misses his best friend - who turns out to be the dead homeless person. Bautz is certain that Hacki, whom he only knows under this name, was killed and the violations of the dead also indicate this. But who had a motif? Is it the homeless Watzke, who is said to have stolen Hackis watch, or Junkie Keule, with whom there was already a dispute? The colleagues of the "Wapo" go to the search and discover Hackis watch. This can reveal his true identity and find his sister. But she had no contact with her brother for years and cannot explain a possible murder at all. The investigation drove in all directions, but Hacki's death remains councilorous. The "Wapo" suddenly focuses on the murder weapon and thus also on the trail of the criminal. Can you successfully clarify the case? / Ein Obdachloser wird tot im Innenhafen gefunden. Carsten Heinrich von der Kripo tut den Fall schnell als Selbstmord ab und uberlasst der "WaPo" die Identifizierung des Opfers. Auf der Wache wartet Marcel Bautz bereits ungeduldig: Er vermisst seinen besten Freund - der sich als der tote Obdachlose herausstellt. Bautz ist sich sicher, dass Hacki, den er nur unter diesem Namen kennt, umgebracht wurde und auch die Verletzungen des Toten deuten darauf hin. Aber wer hatte ein Motiv? Ist es der Obdachlose Watzke, der Hackis Uhr gestohlen haben soll, oder doch Junkie Keule, mit dem es fruher schon Streit gegeben hat? Die Kollegen der "WaPo" machen sich auf die Suche und entdecken Hackis Uhr. Dadurch konnen sie seine wahre Identitat aufdecken und machen seine Schwester ausfindig. Doch die hatte jahrelang keinen Kontakt mehr zu ihrem Bruder und kann sich einen moglichen Mord uberhaupt nicht erklaren. Die Ermittlungen fuhren in alle Richtungen, doch Hackis Tod bleibt weiterhin ratselhaft. Plotzlich stoSSt die "WaPo" auf die Tatwaffe und damit auch auf die Spur des Verbrechers. Konnen sie den Fall erfolgreich aufklaren?

programme.title: Through the wilderness - the adventure of your life / Durch die Wildnis - Das Abenteuer deines Lebens
programme.desc: Yesterday evening the six were allowed to overrun in a self -made tree house over a river. The boys take the opportunity to take a wilderness bath in the ice -cold river. Brrrr! programme.title: Through the wilderness - the adventure of your life / Durch die Wildnis - Das Abenteuer deines Lebens
programme.desc: Washing day in the wilderness: Finally the six can wash a few things. Naturally with biodegradable soap. Then simply span the washing line between your backpack and off you go. programme.title: #Wir - friendship limitless / #WIR - Freundschaft grenzenlos
programme.desc: Curtain for the show girls Larissa and Jana. The two best friends from Rhineland-Palatinate have known each other almost all of their lives. programme.title: Nina and the wild animals / Nina und die wilden Tiere
programme.desc: Nina has traveled to India to find out more about a very special big cat: the leopard. programme.title: Pia und die Haustiere
programme.desc: The job "animal photographer" is a real dream job, but needs to be learned. Because there is much more than a cell phone and a pet. What exactly, Pia finds out. programme.title: Knowledge makes Ah! / Wissen macht Ah!
programme.desc: An uncanny growls excited Clarissa and Ralph. Where does it come from? Hides a clever monster somewhere in "Knowledge makes Ah!" Studio that demands "brain" loudly and audibly? Of course, he knows where it comes from and how you had to deal with it - but feelings are not rational. Durch die Beschaftigung mit der Therapiehundin beginnt sich nicht nur die Mutter zu offnen, sondern auch Emma. Doch reicht die Zeit?Unterdessen bahnt sich fur Paul ein schmerzhafter Verlust an. Immer mehr entfernt sich seine Frau Erina (Nadja Bobyleva) von ihm. Zwar fasst die einstige Starballerina den Entschluss, ihr Leben in die Hand zu nehmen und gegen ihre Behinderung anzukampfen. Naturlich weiSS er berufsbedingt, woher das kommt und wie man damit umgehen musste - doch Gefuhle sind eben nicht rational. Erina zuliebe ist er bereit, sein Leben komplett umzukrempeln.

programme.title: Cathe and me / Kathe und ich
programme.desc: Unfortunately, Roman (Nico Ramon Kleemann) cannot be carefree like other young people. As it turns out, his apathy has an organic cause. The 18-year-old suffers from a life-threatening liver disease. Roman does not want to accept an urgently needed organ donation that his half -sister Jasmina Thomas (Anna Hausburg) offers him despite his dramatic situation. Jasmin desperately turns to the psychologist Paul (Christoph Schechinger): He and his therapy dog ​​Kathe are supposed to convince novels to accept her offer - even if Jasmina puts her health in danger. Soon the experienced therapist realizes that the wrong motive is behind her offer: it is not sibling love, but the desire for the recognition of her father, the founded theater actor Fritz Thomas (Uwe Ochsenknecht). And as Paul finds out, it is a narcissist who also likes to steal responsibility. Paul did not want to evaluate that he does not offer himself as a donor, but it draws him attention to the problematic family relationships. To create them, Paul relies on a holistic approach that also takes Fritz responsible. When Roman's situation deteriorates, there is little time for that. / Unbeschwert sein wie andere Jugendliche, das kann Roman (Nico Ramon Kleemann) leider nicht. Seine Apathie hat, wie sich herausstellt, eine organische Ursache. Der 18-jahrige leidet unter einer lebensgefahrlichen Lebererkrankung. Eine dringend benotigte Organspende, die ihm seine Halbschwester Jasmina Thomas (Anna Hausburg) anbietet, will Roman trotz seiner dramatischen Lage nicht annehmen. Verzweifelt wendet sich Jasmin an den Psychologen Paul (Christoph Schechinger): Er und seine Therapiehundin Kathe sollen Roman uberzeugen, ihr Angebot anzunehmen - auch wenn Jasmina ihre Gesundheit damit in Gefahr bringt. Eine so schwere Entscheidung wie eine Teilleberspende, uber die zudem eine medizinische Kommission befinden muss, bedarf einer stabilen Basis. Begleitet werden sie von den prachtigen Pferdegespannen der Munchner Brauereien, die von edlen Kaltblutern gezogen werden, und vielen Festkutschen und Festwagen, auf denen altes Handwerk und bayerisches Brauchtum gezeigt wird. Die Teilnehmenden kommen nicht nur aus ganz Bayern, sondern auch aus anderen Bundeslandern und europaischen Nachbarstaaten. Als Highlight hat sich 2025 eine Delegation aus den USA angekundigt, wo die Nachkommen von bayerischen Einwanderern bis heute in vielen Trachtenvereinen aktiv sind. Der "Gebirgstrachtenverein Almrausch" in Philadelphia feiert sein 100-jahriges Bestehen und kommt er mit rund 100 Mitgliedern.

programme.title: Murder track of a long -distance driver - the hunt for Marco M. / Mordspur eines Fernfahrers - Die Jagd nach Marco M.
programme.desc: Between 2003 and 2006, truck driver Marco M. murdered and raped three women and seriously injures another. He is brutal, he randomly chooses his victims. Sometimes he only misused women after their death. Then he disposed of her like Mull. "It was his goal to sexually abuse her. And he didn't care if she was dead - the main thing is that he could use her," says criminal psychologist Dr. Gilda Giebel, and their crime scenes are Koln, Moers, Dillenburg and Kassel, mostly near motorways. It is always in motion, remains undisturbed for a long time. Fruh indicate traces of a truck driver with firm routes. But the different crime scenes in different federal countries make the case more difficult. Instead of working together, the Sokos act separately. The foderal structure hinders the exchange. Data protection also brakes the investigation: the toll system, which records the license plates of all truck drivers, was able to help, but the operating company must not issue the data. Every new crime scene brings new investigators, new files, new questions. Only one thing remains the same: the taster. After the testimony of the only lived victim, a phantom image can be created - but the decisive note is missing. There are further murders. In October 2005, a woman disappears into Dillenburg and is discovered 30 kilometers away in a forest. No useful DNA traces, a connection is not recognized. When a school woman is kidnapped and murdered in Kassel nine months later, movement comes to the case. A DNA comparison shows that the deeds in Kassel, Koln and Moers hang together. But the tider remains a phantom. He is not registered, just a short time later brings the turn: a tiny skin scale at the victim's bra from Dillenburg provides the crucial proof: it is one and the same tater here too. His phantom image from Koln is reversed - this time also in Hesse. Two clues drove to Marco M. - an incomprehensible family man from Haiger in Central Hesse. The man can be arrested without resistance. He admits his actions without emotion: He also does not know why that it just came up. In June 2007, the district court Limburg Marco M., known as "Brummi-M are", sentenced to life imprisonment with a preventive preventive detention. The psychiatric report certifies him full guilt - and extremely high willingness to use violence. / Zwischen 2003 und 2006 ermordet und vergewaltigt Lkw-Fahrer Marco M. drei Frauen und verletzt eine weitere schwer. Er geht brutal vor, seine Opfer wahlt er zufallig. Manchmal missbraucht er die Frauen erst nach ihrem Tod. Danach entsorgt er sie wie Mull. "Es war sein Ziel, sie sexuell zu missbrauchen. Und ihm war es dann egal, ob sie tot war, bewusstlos - Hauptsache, er konnte uber sie verfugen", sagt Kriminalpsychologin Dr. Gilda Giebel.Seine Tatorte sind Koln, Moers, Dillenburg und Kassel, meist nahe Autobahnen. Er ist immer in Bewegung, bleibt lange unbehelligt.Fruh deuten Spuren auf einen Lkw-Fahrer mit festen Routen hin. Doch die verschiedenen Tatorte in unterschiedlichen Bundeslandern erschweren den Fall. Statt zusammenzuarbeiten, agieren die SOKOS getrennt. Die foderale Struktur behindert den Austausch. Auch der Datenschutz bremst die Ermittlungen: Das Mautsystem, welches die Kennzeichen aller Lkw-Fahrer erfasst, konnte helfen, doch die Betreiberfirma darf die Daten nicht herausgeben. Jeder neue Tatort bringt neue Ermittler, neue Akten, neue Fragen. Nur eines bleibt gleich: der Tater.Nach der Aussage des einzigen uberlebenden Opfers kann ein Phantombild erstellt werden - doch der entscheidende Hinweis fehlt. Es kommt zu weiteren Morden. Im Oktober 2005 verschwindet eine Frau in Dillenburg und wird 30 Kilometer entfernt tot in einem Wald entdeckt. Keine brauchbaren DNA-Spuren, ein Zusammenhang wird nicht erkannt. Als neun Monate spater in Kassel eine Schulerin verschleppt und ermordet wird, kommt Bewegung in den Fall. Ein DNA-Abgleich zeigt: Die Taten in Kassel, Koln und Moers hangen zusammen. Doch der Tater bleibt ein Phantom. Er ist nicht registriert.Nur kurze Zeit spater bringt ein Zufall die Wende: Eine winzige Hautschuppe am BH des Opfers aus Dillenburg liefert den entscheidenden Beweis: Es ist auch hier ein und derselbe Tater. Sein Phantombild aus Koln wird erneut veroffentlicht - dieses Mal auch in Hessen. Zwei Hinweise fuhren zu Marco M. - einem unauffalligen Familienvater aus dem mittelhessischen Haiger. Der Mann lasst sich widerstandslos festnehmen. Seine Taten gesteht er emotionslos: Er wisse auch nicht warum, es sei einfach uber ihn gekommen.Im Juni 2007 verurteilt das Landgericht Limburg Marco M., bekannt als "Brummi-Morder", zu lebenslanger Haft mit anschlieSSender Sicherungsverwahrung. Das psychiatrische Gutachten bescheinigt ihm volle Schuldfahigkeit - und eine extrem hohe Gewaltbereitschaft.

programme.title: Bay, bricks, polka - the Bohemian Vienna / Buchteln, Ziegeln, Polka - Das bohmische Wien
programme.desc: Vienna around 1900 has a Bohemian face: Czech aristocracy, burger, the so-called "brickbohm" and cookesses the former Habsburg metropolis to this day. From Czech-Bohmischen Stadtpalais, craft businesses, whether Schneider or Schuster, up to coffee house: There is a far-reaching Czech infrastructure in Vienna. Music and especially her eating culture also influence the life of the big city. It is the life stories of cookers who combine with city stories and city walks. Whether in the magnificent palace, in Bohemian Prater, in long -established taverns, at the bricks or in the Belvedere Castle, there are refusions to the Bohemian Kuche and the people behind it. The turn of the century had a high Czech stipulation. Dienstmadchen or as chefs. Numerous recipes from the Bohemian Kuche find their way into the Wiener Kuche. In addition, the bays, livets, knodels, sussels sussen as well as Czech beer as nutritious pay. Few know that behind this traditional Viennese confectionery is a Czech story. There are still a few of the old, Bohemian recipes, and a bohemian classic is still offered at the sausage stand: the clobe, a rooted sausage specialty from the Czech Republic. The "Prague ham" is also based. The recipe in Vienna already maintains a butcher shop in the Funften Generation. In addition, mustard and inserted gem is served and who grilled pork knuckles is preferred in Vienna at the literature known from the literature. He made a name for himself in Vienna with juicy, crispy stilts, with Czech beer. Numerous Czech cultural associations, music ensembles and a Czech school are still established in Vienna and their culture is clearly part of the Viennese identity. A documentation by Anita Lackenberger / Wien um 1900 hat ein bohmisches Gesicht: tschechische Aristokratie, Burgertum, die sogenannten "Ziegelbohm" und Kochinnen pragen die einstige Habsburgermetropole bis heute.Vom tschechisch-bohmischen Stadtpalais, Handwerksbetrieben, ob Schneider oder Schuster, bis hin zu Kaffeehausern: in Wien gibt es eine weitreichende tschechische Infrastruktur. Genauso beeinflussen Musik und insbesondere ihre Esskultur das Leben der GroSSstadt.Die Regisseurin Anita Lackenberger ladt zu einer Spurensuche nach dem vergessenen bohmischen Erbe Wiens. Es sind die Lebensgeschichten von Kochinnen, die sich mit Stadtgeschichten und Stadtspaziergangen verbinden. Ob in den prachtigen Palais, im Bohmischen Prater, in alteingesessenen Wirtshausern, bei den Ziegelteichen oder im Schloss Belvedere, uberall finden sich Bezuge zur bohmischen Kuche und den dahinterstehenden Menschen.Um die Jahrhundertwende hatte Wien einen hohen tschechischen Bevolkerungsanteil.Neben den Arbeitern in den Ziegelwerken im Suden der Stadt sind viele Frauen in den Stadtpalais als Ammen, Dienstmadchen oder als Kochinnen im Einsatz. So finden zahlreiche Rezepte aus der bohmischen Kuche Eingang in die Wiener Kuche. Dazu zahlen die Buchteln, Liwanzen, Knodel, suSSe SoSSen zum Braten genauso wie das tschechische Bier als nahrhaftes Getrank.Damals wie heute trifft man sich, vor allem wenn es "wienerisch" sein soll, in der Konditorei Aida. Nur wenige wissen, dass sich hinter dieser Wiener Traditionskonditorei eine tschechische Geschichte verbirgt. Ein paar der alten, bohmischen Rezepte gibt es noch.Selbst beim Wurstelstand wird noch heute ein bohmischer Klassiker angeboten: die Klobasse, eine wurzige Wurstspezialitat aus Tschechien. Beruhmt ist auch der "Prager Schinken". Die Rezeptur pflegt in Wien eine Fleischerei bereits in der funften Generation. Dazu serviert wird Senf und eingelegtes Gemuse.Und wer Schweinshaxen gegrillt bevorzugt wird in Wien beim aus der Literatur bekannten Herrn Kolarik fundig. Er hat sich in Wien mit saftig, knusprigen Stelzen, serviert mit tschechischem Bier, einen Namen gemacht.Die tschechische Diaspora in Wien hat eine lange Geschichte, auch nach dem Zuzug um 1900. Das wechselvolle 20. Jahrhundert hat Wien oft zur Zufluchtsstatte werden lassen. Zahlreiche tschechische Kulturvereine, Musikensembles sowie eine tschechische Schule sind in Wien bis heute etabliert und deren Kultur ist deutlich bis heute Teil der Wiener Identitat.Eine Dokumentation von Anita Lackenberger

programme.title: Erlebnis Österreich
programme.sub-title: Hof Castle - Prince Eugen builds his dream / Schloss Hof - Prinz Eugen baut seinen Traum
programme.desc: He was the greatest of his time. He was one of the richest men of his time. And he was one of the greatest art collectors of his time. Prince Eugen of Savoy-Carignan acquired the 40 kilometers of Vienna in 1725 and began to transform the original Renaissance castle into a baroque palace complex. With the most basic planners, architects, garden designers and furniture designers - this was how it was described today. This "Experience Austria" from the ORF Landesstudio Niederosterreich (design: Barbara Baldauf, camera: Franz Cee) sets out for the trace of traces of the man Prince Eugen, tries to scrape his passions, to illuminate his facilities and to recognize his grade. Fur Prince Eugen was nothing too expensive and seemingly nothing good enough. His winter palace and the Belvedere in Vienna still pay to the most impressive baroque buildings in the Esterreich capital. He wanted to continue realizing his dreams in Hof Castle and he managed to calm down in a age in which others have long calmed down. When Prince Eugen Schloss Hof acquired Hof, he was 62 years old. He commissioned the architect Johann Lucas von Hildebrandt to build a repressant hunting seat from the licked Renaissance kastell with a rectangular floor plan. So a building was built on the landing of Castle Hof in a short time that no wish left open. The castle was delivered to the west around two flight buildings. Until the death of Prince Eugens, over 800 craftsmen were also bustled with seven terraces. For the exquisite equipment of the palace rooms - on the first floor there were Prince Eugen's residential apartment, the parade apartment, 13 guest room, the chapel and the ballroom - those artists who had already earned in the Belvedere castle were already involved. Among them were the interior decorator Claude Le Fort Du Plessy and the plasterers Santino Bussi and Alberto Camesina. A special exhibition is dedicated to the 300-year existence of Hof in the Baroque Castle Hof and also in the Lower Weiden Castle in his design by Prince Eugen. The "Eugen behind the Prince" is also illuminated. The rapid rise of Eugen as a general and war minister, the many facets of the brilliant networker and manic collector, his role at the center of an elite group of friends and arts and the prompt shape of the Esterreichian baroque. How did the prince get to all the exotic plants and animals, to the exquisite fabrics and ceramics, where does his thousands of bookers come from, what drove him to deal with philosophy? In 1736, Prince Eugen died in the 73rd year of life childless before the final completion of his Castle Hof, his inheritance is now accessible to all visitor of the impressive castle. / Er war der groSSte Kriegsheld seiner Zeit. Er war einer der reichsten Manner seiner Zeit. Und er war einer der groSSten Kunstsammler seiner Zeit. Prinz Eugen von Savoyen-Carignan erwarb 1725 die 40 Kilometer ostlich von Wien gelegene Herrschaft Hof und begann das ursprungliche Renaissance-Kastell zu einer barocken Schlossanlage umzugestalten. Mit den beruhmtesten Planern, Architekten, Gartengestaltern und Mobeldesignern - so wurde man das heute bezeichnen. Dieses "Erlebnis Österreich" aus dem ORF Landesstudio Niederosterreich (Gestaltung: Barbara Baldauf, Kamera: Franz Cee) macht sich auf die Spurensuche nach dem Mann Prinz Eugen, versucht seine Leidenschaften zu ergrunden, seine Fahigkeiten zu beleuchten und seine Note zu erkennen.Fur Prinz Eugen war nichts zu teuer und scheinbar auch nichts gut genug. Sein Winterpalais und das Belvedere in Wien zahlen bis heute zu den beeindruckendsten Barockbauten der osterreichischen Hauptstadt. In Schloss Hof wollte er seine Traume weiter verwirklichen und es gelang ihm in einem Lebensalter, in dem sich andere langst zur Ruhe gesetzt haben. Als Prinz Eugen Schloss Hof erwarb, war er 62 Jahre alt. Er beauftragte den Architekten Johann Lucas von Hildebrandt aus dem einstockigen Renaissancekastell mit rechteckigem Grundriss einen reprasentativen Jagdsitz zu errichten. So entstand am Gelande von Schloss Hof in kurzester Zeit ein Gebaude, das keine Wunsche offenlieSS. Das Schloss wurde um zwei Flugelbauten nach Westen hin verlangert. Über 800 Handwerker waren bis zum Tode Prinz Eugens unter anderem auch damit beschaftigt, einen weitlaufigen Garten mit sieben Terrassen anzulegen. Fur die exquisite Ausstattung der Schlossraume - im ersten Stock befanden sich Prinz Eugens Wohnappartement, das Paradeappartement, 13 Gastezimmer, die Kapelle und der Festsaal - wurden jene Kunstler engagiert, die sich bereits unter anderem in den Belvedere Schlossern verdient gemacht hatten. Darunter waren der Innendekorateur Claude Le Fort du Plessy sowie die Stuckateure Santino Bussi und Alberto Camesina.Eine Sonderausstellung widmet sich im barocken Schloss Hof und auch im Schloss Niederweiden dem 300-jahrigen Bestehen von Schloss Hof in seiner Gestaltung durch Prinz Eugen. Dabei wird auch der "Eugen hinter dem Prinzen" beleuchtet. Der rasante Aufstieg Eugens als Feldherr und Kriegsminister, die vielen Facetten des brillanten Netzwerkers und manischen Sammlers, seine Rolle im Mittelpunkt eines elitaren Freundes- und Kunstlerkreises und die pragende Gestalt des osterreichischen Barocks. Wie kam der Prinz zu all den exotischen Pflanzen und Tieren, zu den erlesenen Stoffen und Keramiken, woher stammt seine tausende Bucher umfassende Bibliothek, was trieb ihn an, sich mit Philosophie zu beschaftigen?1736 stirbt Prinz Eugen im 73. Lebensjahr kinderlos noch vor der endgultigen Vollendung seines Schloss Hof Traums, sein Erbe ist heute allen Besuchern der beeindruckenden Schlossanlage zuganglich.

As early as 1610, the Haller doctor Hippolyt Guarinoni explored the region and initiated the construction of the Karlskirche in Volders and other chapels. It is interesting to see the story of a farmer from Navis who was seen 50 years ago in one of the first "Austria pictures". / Die Tuxer Alpen, umgeben von den Zillertaler Alpen, Stubaier Alpen und dem Karwendel, sind weniger bekannt, aber dennoch beeindruckend. Im Zentrum befindet sich die Wattener Lizum: genutzt vom Bundesheer, einer Alpenvereinshutte und der Almwirtschaft. Bereits 1610 erkundete der Haller Arzt Hippolyt Guarinoni die Region und initiierte den Bau der Karlskirche in Volders sowie weiterer Kapellen. In Hintertux gibt es ein altes Thermalbad, das noch in Betrieb ist. Interessant ist die Geschichte eines Bauern aus Navis, der vor 50 Jahren in einem der ersten "Österreich Bilder" zu sehen war.

programme.title: Menschen and Machte
programme.sub-title: Recht nicht Rache. Der Zeitzeuge Simon Wiesenthal
programme.desc: On September 20th, Simon Wiesenthal's annual day of death. He was more than the much -cited Nazi hunter. He was a "guard of memory". And it is precisely this reminder of the memory of the Holocaust for Simon Wiesenthal did not have an expiry date. For decades, Wiesenthal claimed Austria's commitment to joint responsibility for the crimes of National Socialism. As a contemporary witness of Jewish suffering, he became a moral conscience against racism and hostility to foreigners. In his books and presentation, he wanted to convey the networked connection between the past, present and the future. / Am 20. September jahrt sich zum 20. Mal der Todestag von Simon Wiesenthal. Er war mehr als der vielzitierte Nazijager. Er war ein "Wachter der Erinnerung". Und eben dieses Wachhalten der Erinnerung an den Holocaust besaSS fur Simon Wiesenthal kein Ablaufdatum. Jahrzehntelang forderte Wiesenthal das Bekenntnis Österreichs zur Mitverantwortung an den Verbrechen des Nationalsozialismus ein. Als Zeitzeuge des judischen Leidens wurde er zum moralischen Gewissen gegen Rassismus und Auslanderfeindlichkeit. In seinen Buchern und Vortragen wollte er vor allem der Jugend die vernetzten Zusammenhange zwischen Vergangenheit, Gegenwart und Zukunft vermitteln.Eine Dokumentation von Andreas Novak

programme.title: Bay, bricks, polka - the Bohemian Vienna / Buchteln, Ziegeln, Polka - Das bohmische Wien
programme.desc: Vienna around 1900 has a Bohemian face: Czech aristocracy, burger, the so-called "brickbohm" and cookesses the former Habsburg metropolis to this day. From Czech-Bohmischen Stadtpalais, craft businesses, whether Schneider or Schuster, up to coffee house: There is a far-reaching Czech infrastructure in Vienna. Music and especially her eating culture also influence the life of the big city. It is the life stories of cookers who combine with city stories and city walks. Whether in the magnificent palace, in Bohemian Prater, in long -established taverns, at the bricks or in the Belvedere Castle, there are refusions to the Bohemian Kuche and the people behind it. The turn of the century had a high Czech stipulation. Dienstmadchen or as chefs. Numerous recipes from the Bohemian Kuche find their way into the Wiener Kuche. In addition, the bays, livets, knodels, sussels sussen as well as Czech beer as nutritious pay. Few know that behind this traditional Viennese confectionery is a Czech story. There are still a few of the old, Bohemian recipes, and a bohemian classic is still offered at the sausage stand: the clobe, a rooted sausage specialty from the Czech Republic. The "Prague ham" is also based. The recipe in Vienna already maintains a butcher shop in the Funften Generation. In addition, mustard and inserted gem is served and who grilled pork knuckles is preferred in Vienna at the literature known from the literature. He made a name for himself in Vienna with juicy, crispy stilts, with Czech beer. Numerous Czech cultural associations, music ensembles and a Czech school are still established in Vienna and their culture is clearly part of the Viennese identity. A documentation by Anita Lackenberger / Wien um 1900 hat ein bohmisches Gesicht: tschechische Aristokratie, Burgertum, die sogenannten "Ziegelbohm" und Kochinnen pragen die einstige Habsburgermetropole bis heute.Vom tschechisch-bohmischen Stadtpalais, Handwerksbetrieben, ob Schneider oder Schuster, bis hin zu Kaffeehausern: in Wien gibt es eine weitreichende tschechische Infrastruktur. Genauso beeinflussen Musik und insbesondere ihre Esskultur das Leben der GroSSstadt.Die Regisseurin Anita Lackenberger ladt zu einer Spurensuche nach dem vergessenen bohmischen Erbe Wiens. Es sind die Lebensgeschichten von Kochinnen, die sich mit Stadtgeschichten und Stadtspaziergangen verbinden. Ob in den prachtigen Palais, im Bohmischen Prater, in alteingesessenen Wirtshausern, bei den Ziegelteichen oder im Schloss Belvedere, uberall finden sich Bezuge zur bohmischen Kuche und den dahinterstehenden Menschen.Um die Jahrhundertwende hatte Wien einen hohen tschechischen Bevolkerungsanteil.Neben den Arbeitern in den Ziegelwerken im Suden der Stadt sind viele Frauen in den Stadtpalais als Ammen, Dienstmadchen oder als Kochinnen im Einsatz. So finden zahlreiche Rezepte aus der bohmischen Kuche Eingang in die Wiener Kuche. Dazu zahlen die Buchteln, Liwanzen, Knodel, suSSe SoSSen zum Braten genauso wie das tschechische Bier als nahrhaftes Getrank.Damals wie heute trifft man sich, vor allem wenn es "wienerisch" sein soll, in der Konditorei Aida. Nur wenige wissen, dass sich hinter dieser Wiener Traditionskonditorei eine tschechische Geschichte verbirgt. Ein paar der alten, bohmischen Rezepte gibt es noch.Selbst beim Wurstelstand wird noch heute ein bohmischer Klassiker angeboten: die Klobasse, eine wurzige Wurstspezialitat aus Tschechien. Beruhmt ist auch der "Prager Schinken". Die Rezeptur pflegt in Wien eine Fleischerei bereits in der funften Generation. Dazu serviert wird Senf und eingelegtes Gemuse.Und wer Schweinshaxen gegrillt bevorzugt wird in Wien beim aus der Literatur bekannten Herrn Kolarik fundig. Er hat sich in Wien mit saftig, knusprigen Stelzen, serviert mit tschechischem Bier, einen Namen gemacht.Die tschechische Diaspora in Wien hat eine lange Geschichte, auch nach dem Zuzug um 1900. Das wechselvolle 20. Jahrhundert hat Wien oft zur Zufluchtsstatte werden lassen. Zahlreiche tschechische Kulturvereine, Musikensembles sowie eine tschechische Schule sind in Wien bis heute etabliert und deren Kultur ist deutlich bis heute Teil der Wiener Identitat.Eine Dokumentation von Anita Lackenberger

programme.title: Erlebnis Österreich
programme.sub-title: Hof Castle - Prince Eugen builds his dream / Schloss Hof - Prinz Eugen baut seinen Traum
programme.desc: He was the greatest of his time. He was one of the richest men of his time. And he was one of the greatest art collectors of his time. Prince Eugen of Savoy-Carignan acquired the 40 kilometers of Vienna in 1725 and began to transform the original Renaissance castle into a baroque palace complex. With the most basic planners, architects, garden designers and furniture designers - this was how it was described today. This "Experience Austria" from the ORF Landesstudio Niederosterreich (design: Barbara Baldauf, camera: Franz Cee) sets out for the trace of traces of the man Prince Eugen, tries to scrape his passions, to illuminate his facilities and to recognize his grade. Fur Prince Eugen was nothing too expensive and seemingly nothing good enough. His winter palace and the Belvedere in Vienna still pay to the most impressive baroque buildings in the Esterreich capital. He wanted to continue realizing his dreams in Hof Castle and he managed to calm down in a age in which others have long calmed down. When Prince Eugen Schloss Hof acquired Hof, he was 62 years old. He commissioned the architect Johann Lucas von Hildebrandt to build a repressant hunting seat from the licked Renaissance kastell with a rectangular floor plan. So a building was built on the landing of Castle Hof in a short time that no wish left open. The castle was delivered to the west around two flight buildings. Until the death of Prince Eugens, over 800 craftsmen were also bustled with seven terraces. For the exquisite equipment of the palace rooms - on the first floor there were Prince Eugen's residential apartment, the parade apartment, 13 guest room, the chapel and the ballroom - those artists who had already earned in the Belvedere castle were already involved. Among them were the interior decorator Claude Le Fort Du Plessy and the plasterers Santino Bussi and Alberto Camesina. A special exhibition is dedicated to the 300-year existence of Hof in the Baroque Castle Hof and also in the Lower Weiden Castle in his design by Prince Eugen. The "Eugen behind the Prince" is also illuminated. The rapid rise of Eugen as a general and war minister, the many facets of the brilliant networker and manic collector, his role at the center of an elite group of friends and arts and the prompt shape of the Esterreichian baroque. How did the prince get to all the exotic plants and animals, to the exquisite fabrics and ceramics, where does his thousands of bookers come from, what drove him to deal with philosophy? In 1736, Prince Eugen died in the 73rd year of life childless before the final completion of his Castle Hof, his inheritance is now accessible to all visitor of the impressive castle. / Er war der groSSte Kriegsheld seiner Zeit. Er war einer der reichsten Manner seiner Zeit. Und er war einer der groSSten Kunstsammler seiner Zeit. Prinz Eugen von Savoyen-Carignan erwarb 1725 die 40 Kilometer ostlich von Wien gelegene Herrschaft Hof und begann das ursprungliche Renaissance-Kastell zu einer barocken Schlossanlage umzugestalten. Mit den beruhmtesten Planern, Architekten, Gartengestaltern und Mobeldesignern - so wurde man das heute bezeichnen. Dieses "Erlebnis Österreich" aus dem ORF Landesstudio Niederosterreich (Gestaltung: Barbara Baldauf, Kamera: Franz Cee) macht sich auf die Spurensuche nach dem Mann Prinz Eugen, versucht seine Leidenschaften zu ergrunden, seine Fahigkeiten zu beleuchten und seine Note zu erkennen.Fur Prinz Eugen war nichts zu teuer und scheinbar auch nichts gut genug. Sein Winterpalais und das Belvedere in Wien zahlen bis heute zu den beeindruckendsten Barockbauten der osterreichischen Hauptstadt. In Schloss Hof wollte er seine Traume weiter verwirklichen und es gelang ihm in einem Lebensalter, in dem sich andere langst zur Ruhe gesetzt haben. Als Prinz Eugen Schloss Hof erwarb, war er 62 Jahre alt. Er beauftragte den Architekten Johann Lucas von Hildebrandt aus dem einstockigen Renaissancekastell mit rechteckigem Grundriss einen reprasentativen Jagdsitz zu errichten. So entstand am Gelande von Schloss Hof in kurzester Zeit ein Gebaude, das keine Wunsche offenlieSS. Das Schloss wurde um zwei Flugelbauten nach Westen hin verlangert. Über 800 Handwerker waren bis zum Tode Prinz Eugens unter anderem auch damit beschaftigt, einen weitlaufigen Garten mit sieben Terrassen anzulegen. Fur die exquisite Ausstattung der Schlossraume - im ersten Stock befanden sich Prinz Eugens Wohnappartement, das Paradeappartement, 13 Gastezimmer, die Kapelle und der Festsaal - wurden jene Kunstler engagiert, die sich bereits unter anderem in den Belvedere Schlossern verdient gemacht hatten. Darunter waren der Innendekorateur Claude Le Fort du Plessy sowie die Stuckateure Santino Bussi und Alberto Camesina.Eine Sonderausstellung widmet sich im barocken Schloss Hof und auch im Schloss Niederweiden dem 300-jahrigen Bestehen von Schloss Hof in seiner Gestaltung durch Prinz Eugen. Dabei wird auch der "Eugen hinter dem Prinzen" beleuchtet. Der rasante Aufstieg Eugens als Feldherr und Kriegsminister, die vielen Facetten des brillanten Netzwerkers und manischen Sammlers, seine Rolle im Mittelpunkt eines elitaren Freundes- und Kunstlerkreises und die pragende Gestalt des osterreichischen Barocks. Wie kam der Prinz zu all den exotischen Pflanzen und Tieren, zu den erlesenen Stoffen und Keramiken, woher stammt seine tausende Bucher umfassende Bibliothek, was trieb ihn an, sich mit Philosophie zu beschaftigen?1736 stirbt Prinz Eugen im 73. Lebensjahr kinderlos noch vor der endgultigen Vollendung seines Schloss Hof Traums, sein Erbe ist heute allen Besuchern der beeindruckenden Schlossanlage zuganglich.

programme.title: Thema
programme.desc: Abuse in the children's village - if the silence has a system "I was beaten, locked up and humiliated," says Natascha S. her last name did not want to verof. The 35-year-old spent her childhood in S.O.'s children's village in Moosburg in Karnten. A children's village mother hit her so brutally in the face that she blinds her in one eye. In her time in the children's village, she had five different village nuts. One of them says in the "topic" interview: "If I had the leadership of the violence of my colleagues, I was not wanted to be heard." A study shows which gray relates took place in Moosburg from 2008 to 2020. But violence may have been for some children in the children's village of Bitter everyday life decades earlier. Leon Hoffmann -Eastenhof and Savanka Schwarz with an investigative search. Life after the killing run - start of school in the Borg Dreierschutzengasse "Why can I live on? And why are the others dead?" That wonders Sam Askari every day. The 16-year-old just has English lessons when the amocla run enters his class and shoots him in his head. Since then, half of his face has been paralyzed. On June 10th, ten people will be totted in the Borg Dreierschutzengasse in Graz. Your chairs remain empty on the first day of school. "It is a strange start to school. Many of us don't talk about what happened," says Selin Ceylan. How was the start of school for the schools? Leon Hoffmann-Eastenhof has met some of them for the conversation. She wears a cochlea implant and works as a Horgerateakustiker in Linz. Nevertheless, for the daughter of Horender parents, the building language is their mother tongue. It is the language in which she dreams and seals. During the ORF casting "Make yourself visible" she performed with her building poetry. The Horende Wiener Branislav Zdravkovic is the translator for his heavy -wing mother Olgica Gruber in everyday life. Be it at hand or when a new kitchen is bought. The son is always there. Only since September 1, 2005, the Austrian building language has been recognized as an own language of a non-ethnic minority. For 8,000 to 10,000 people, it is the first language. It has its own grammar and her own poetry. There are still too few interpreters: inside and educational offers. A report by Andrea Poschmaier and Pia Bichara. / Missbrauch im Kinderdorf - wenn das Schweigen System hat"Ich wurde geschlagen, eingesperrt und erniedrigt", sagt Natascha S. Ihren Nachnamen mochte sie nicht veroffentlichen. Die 35-Jahrige hat ihre Kindheit im S.O.S Kinderdorf in Moosburg in Karnten verbracht. Eine Kinderdorfmutter schlagt sie damals so brutal ins Gesicht, dass sie auf einem Auge erblindet, erzahlt sie. In ihrer Zeit im Kinderdorf hatte sie funf verschiedene Dorfmutter. Eine von ihnen sagt im "Thema"-Interview: "Wenn ich der Leitung von der Gewalt meiner Kolleginnen erzahlt habe, wollte man mir nicht zuhoren." Eine Studie belegt, welche Graueltaten sich in Moosburg von 2008 bis 2020 abgespielt haben. Doch Gewalt durfte schon Jahrzehnte zuvor fur manche Kinder im Kinderdorf bitterer Alltag gewesen sein. Leon Hoffmann-Ostenhof und Savanka Schwarz mit einer Investigativrecherche.Leben nach dem Amoklauf - Schulbeginn im BORG Dreierschutzengasse"Warum darf ich weiterleben? Und warum sind die anderen tot?" Das fragt sich Sam Askari jeden Tag. Der 16-Jahrige hat gerade Englischunterricht, als der Amoklaufer seine Klasse betritt und ihm in den Kopf schieSSt. Seitdem ist eine Halfte seines Gesichts gelahmt. Am 10. Juni werden im BORG Dreierschutzengasse in Graz zehn Menschen getotet. Ihre Stuhle bleiben am ersten Schultag leer. "Es ist ein komischer Schulstart. Viele von uns reden nicht uber das, was passiert ist", sagt Selin Ceylan. Wie war der Schulbeginn fur die Schulerinnen und Schuler? Leon Hoffmann-Ostenhof hat einige von ihnen zum Gesprach getroffen.Muttersprache Gebardensprache - 20 Jahre AnerkennungDie 31-jahrige Anja Burghardt ist seit ihrer Geburt schwerhorig. Sie tragt ein Cochlea-Implantat und arbeitet als Horgerateakustikerin in Linz. Dennoch ist fur die Tochter horender Eltern die Gebardensprache ihre Muttersprache. Es ist die Sprache, in der sie traumt und dichtet. Beim ORF-Casting "Mach dich sichtbar" trat sie mit ihrer Gebarden-Poetry auf. Der horende Wiener Branislav Zdravkovic ist im Alltag der Übersetzer fur seine schwerhorige Mutter Olgica Gruber. Sei es bei Behordengangen oder wenn eine neue Kuche gekauft wird. Immer ist der Sohn mit dabei. Erst seit 1. September 2005 ist die Österreichische Gebardensprache als eigenstandige Sprache einer nicht-ethnischen Minderheit anerkannt. Fur 8.000 bis 10.000 Menschen ist sie die Erstsprache. Sie hat eine eigene Grammatik und eine eigene Poesie. Immer noch gibt es zu wenig Dolmetscher:innen und Bildungsangebote. Eine Reportage von Andrea Poschmaier und Pia Bichara.

programme.title: kulturMONTAG
programme.desc: War and peace can you talk about peace when wars are normality? Under the title "Never Again Peace", the 58th edition of the "Styrian Autumn" festival is devoted to an issue that could not be more current. Ernst Toller's anti -fascist satire "Never again peace", which was created in 1936, forms the starting point for numerous artistic projects on the past and today's conflicts. Dimitre calls Dinev "time of the brave", who fled from Bulgaria to Austria in 1990 is his opus magnum. It is a very personal billing with its former homeland, in which he traces the leading atmosphere in the former communist-fascist country and explores the history of Europe. Abuse of power, leaked chats, corruption scandals on theater stages? While the media landscape has been fighting for the trust of its readership for years, daily and social policy gradually conquers the boards that mean the world. Investigative research platforms such as "Dossier", "Therefore" or the "Institute for Media, Politics and Theater" put virulent topics in the spotlight. The "cultural monument" about the trend towards research theater. / Krieg and FriedenWie kann man uber Frieden reden, wenn Kriege Normalitat sind? Unter dem Titel "Never Again Peace" widmet sich die 58. Ausgabe des "steirischen herbst"-Festivals einem Thema, das aktueller nicht sein konnte. Ernst Tollers antifaschistische Satire "Nie wieder Friede", die 1936 entstanden ist bildet dabei den Ausgangspunkt fur zahlreiche kunstlerische Projekte zu den vergangenen wie heutigen Konflikten. "Zeit der Mutigen" nennt Dimitre Dinev, der 1990 aus Bulgarien nach Österreich geflohen ist sein Opus Magnum. Es ist eine sehr personliche Abrechnung mit seiner einstigen Heimat, in der er die bleierne Atmosphare in dem einstig kommunistisch-faschistischen Land nachzeichnet und dabei die Geschichte Europas erkundet. Machtmissbrauch, geleakte Chats, Korruptionsskandale auf Theaterbuhnen? Wahrend die Medienlandschaft seit Jahren um das Vertrauen ihrer Leserschaft kampft, erobert Tages- wie Gesellschaftspolitik sukzessive die Bretter, die die Welt bedeuten. Investigative Rechercheplattformen wie "Dossier", "Darum" oder das "Institut fur Medien, Politik und Theater" stellen virulente Themen ins Rampenlicht. Der "kulturMONTAG" uber den Trend zum Recherche-Theater.

programme.title: Sugar - Vater des Italo -blues / Zucchero - Vater des Italo-Blues
programme.desc: The film is a portrait of the legendary Italian singer, multi-instrumentalist Songwriters and Blues musicians Zucchero, which shows the exclusive footage from its private archives and its world tour and lets know well-known companions such as Bono, Sting and Andrea Bocelli. They all report on a man who impressed them both as an artist and as a human being. The documentary is paid by Zucchero's childhood experiences, its persistence, international success, its strong and the years of depression that he had to overcome. A cinematic journey to his roots, which not only reveals the life of a musician, but also shows the inner conflicts and human weak of a man who, despite everything, never lost courage. / Der Film ist ein Portrat des legendaren italienischen Sangers, Multiinstrumentalisten Songwriters und Blues-Musikers Zucchero, das exklusives Filmmaterial aus seinen Privatarchiven und seiner Welttournee zeigt und bekannte Wegbegleiter wie Bono, Sting und Andrea Bocelli zu Wort kommen lasst. Sie alle berichten von einem Mann, der sie sowohl als Kunstler als auch als Mensch beeindruckt hat. Die Doku erzahlt von Zuccheros Kindheitserlebnissen, seiner Hartnackigkeit, internationalen Erfolg zu erlangen, seiner Starke und den Jahren der Depression, die er uberwinden musste. Eine filmische Reise zu seinen Wurzeln, die nicht nur das Leben eines Musikers offenbart, sondern auch die inneren Konflikte und menschlichen Schwachen eines Mannes zeigt, der trotz allem niemals den Mut verlor.

Sie tragt ein Cochlea-Implantat und arbeitet als Horgerateakustikerin in Linz. Dennoch ist fur die Tochter horender Eltern die Gebardensprache ihre Muttersprache. Es ist die Sprache, in der sie traumt und dichtet. Beim ORF-Casting "Mach dich sichtbar" trat sie mit ihrer Gebarden-Poetry auf. Der horende Wiener Branislav Zdravkovic ist im Alltag der Übersetzer fur seine schwerhorige Mutter Olgica Gruber. Sei es bei Behordengangen oder wenn eine neue Kuche gekauft wird. Immer ist der Sohn mit dabei. Erst seit 1. September 2005 ist die Österreichische Gebardensprache als eigenstandige Sprache einer nicht-ethnischen Minderheit anerkannt. Fur 8.000 bis 10.000 Menschen ist sie die Erstsprache. Sie hat eine eigene Grammatik und eine eigene Poesie. Immer noch gibt es zu wenig Dolmetscher:innen und Bildungsangebote. Eine Reportage von Andrea Poschmaier und Pia Bichara.

programme.title: Bay, bricks, polka - the Bohemian Vienna / Buchteln, Ziegeln, Polka - Das bohmische Wien
programme.desc: Vienna around 1900 has a Bohemian face: Czech aristocracy, burger, the so-called "brickbohm" and cookesses the former Habsburg metropolis to this day. From Czech-Bohmischen Stadtpalais, craft businesses, whether Schneider or Schuster, up to coffee house: There is a far-reaching Czech infrastructure in Vienna. Music and especially her eating culture also influence the life of the big city. It is the life stories of cookers who combine with city stories and city walks. Whether in the magnificent palace, in Bohemian Prater, in long -established taverns, at the bricks or in the Belvedere Castle, there are refusions to the Bohemian Kuche and the people behind it. The turn of the century had a high Czech stipulation. Dienstmadchen or as chefs. Numerous recipes from the Bohemian Kuche find their way into the Wiener Kuche. In addition, the bays, livets, knodels, sussels sussen as well as Czech beer as nutritious pay. Few know that behind this traditional Viennese confectionery is a Czech story. There are still a few of the old, Bohemian recipes, and a bohemian classic is still offered at the sausage stand: the clobe, a rooted sausage specialty from the Czech Republic. The "Prague ham" is also based. The recipe in Vienna already maintains a butcher shop in the Funften Generation. In addition, mustard and inserted gem is served and who grilled pork knuckles is preferred in Vienna at the literature known from the literature. He made a name for himself in Vienna with juicy, crispy stilts, with Czech beer. Numerous Czech cultural associations, music ensembles and a Czech school are still established in Vienna and their culture is clearly part of the Viennese identity. A documentation by Anita Lackenberger / Wien um 1900 hat ein bohmisches Gesicht: tschechische Aristokratie, Burgertum, die sogenannten "Ziegelbohm" und Kochinnen pragen die einstige Habsburgermetropole bis heute.Vom tschechisch-bohmischen Stadtpalais, Handwerksbetrieben, ob Schneider oder Schuster, bis hin zu Kaffeehausern: in Wien gibt es eine weitreichende tschechische Infrastruktur. Genauso beeinflussen Musik und insbesondere ihre Esskultur das Leben der GroSSstadt.Die Regisseurin Anita Lackenberger ladt zu einer Spurensuche nach dem vergessenen bohmischen Erbe Wiens. Es sind die Lebensgeschichten von Kochinnen, die sich mit Stadtgeschichten und Stadtspaziergangen verbinden. Ob in den prachtigen Palais, im Bohmischen Prater, in alteingesessenen Wirtshausern, bei den Ziegelteichen oder im Schloss Belvedere, uberall finden sich Bezuge zur bohmischen Kuche und den dahinterstehenden Menschen.Um die Jahrhundertwende hatte Wien einen hohen tschechischen Bevolkerungsanteil.Neben den Arbeitern in den Ziegelwerken im Suden der Stadt sind viele Frauen in den Stadtpalais als Ammen, Dienstmadchen oder als Kochinnen im Einsatz. So finden zahlreiche Rezepte aus der bohmischen Kuche Eingang in die Wiener Kuche. Dazu zahlen die Buchteln, Liwanzen, Knodel, suSSe SoSSen zum Braten genauso wie das tschechische Bier als nahrhaftes Getrank.Damals wie heute trifft man sich, vor allem wenn es "wienerisch" sein soll, in der Konditorei Aida. Nur wenige wissen, dass sich hinter dieser Wiener Traditionskonditorei eine tschechische Geschichte verbirgt. Ein paar der alten, bohmischen Rezepte gibt es noch.Selbst beim Wurstelstand wird noch heute ein bohmischer Klassiker angeboten: die Klobasse, eine wurzige Wurstspezialitat aus Tschechien. Beruhmt ist auch der "Prager Schinken". Die Rezeptur pflegt in Wien eine Fleischerei bereits in der funften Generation. Dazu serviert wird Senf und eingelegtes Gemuse.Und wer Schweinshaxen gegrillt bevorzugt wird in Wien beim aus der Literatur bekannten Herrn Kolarik fundig. Er hat sich in Wien mit saftig, knusprigen Stelzen, serviert mit tschechischem Bier, einen Namen gemacht.Die tschechische Diaspora in Wien hat eine lange Geschichte, auch nach dem Zuzug um 1900. Das wechselvolle 20. Jahrhundert hat Wien oft zur Zufluchtsstatte werden lassen. Zahlreiche tschechische Kulturvereine, Musikensembles sowie eine tschechische Schule sind in Wien bis heute etabliert und deren Kultur ist deutlich bis heute Teil der Wiener Identitat.Eine Dokumentation von Anita Lackenberger
